{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness desktop shell — Tauri v2, tray + native webchat + task-done toasts, single portable exe","id":"gh:1333850130","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-desktop-windowos","slug":"RAFOLIE/dsh-desktop-windowos","topics":["deepseek","deepseek-harness","desktop","dsh","dsh-plugin","tauri","typescript","windows"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness desktop shell — Tauri v2, tray + native webchat + task-done toasts, single portable"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"Seek Harness desktop shell — Tauri v2, tray + native webchat + task-done toasts, single portable exe"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH Desktop (dsh-desktop-windowos)"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**中文 | En**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"### 功能"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **开箱即用**:双击 exe 启动本机 DSH 并嵌入原生 webchat。已安装候选等待最多 120 秒，npx 最多 300 秒；通过只读包文件识别 `--no-open`，不会为参数检测启"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"动 profile。
- **自绘标题栏**:无边框窗口,Comfy 式**胶囊控件**(鲸鱼标+名字+箭头)整颗居中——**点击打开环境管理面板**(开启态蓝边高亮、箭头翻转);拖拽区/最小化/最大"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"化/关闭自绘,Win 贴靠与边缘缩放原生保留
- **设置工作区**:点击标题栏胶囊打开左右布局的设置页，包含常规、外观、环境、更新和日志；支持全局设置搜索、图标导航、键盘操作与窄窗口布局。聊天 if"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"rame 常驻，切换设置页保留聊天状态。
- **外观定制**:浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统；DSH、海洋、森林、紫罗兰、琥珀、玫瑰六个预设。分别设置强调色、背景色、文字、前景卡片和顶部/侧栏边框色；"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"自由选色、层次对比度、字体字号、手形光标和半透明侧栏。主题支持复制、粘贴、导入与重置；语言位于常规。
- **日志体系(ComfyUI 式)**:dsh.log 只记壳自身事件(启动/监护/更新;DS"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"H web 输出不入日志,不再膨胀),`[本地时间] [INFO/WARN/ERROR]` 格式逐行着色,每次启动轮转历史文件;启动页「查看日志」实时看终端在跑什么;日志页带等级筛选/自动跟随/清空显"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"示
- **诊断包**:面板「更多 → 导出诊断信息」一键把环境配置+本次日志组装成 markdown——复制到剪贴板可直接粘贴给 AI 排障,无需翻目录查全局安装
- **托盘常驻**:关闭窗口(X"},{"id":"p5s8","text":")只是隐藏到托盘,DSH 后台继续运行;**双击托盘图标**或**右键 → Open DSH** 随时唤回窗口;右键还有「重启 dsh web(后端)」「前后端重启」「检查前端更新」「环境信息」

Installed candidates get 120 seconds; "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"npx gets 300. Read-only package inspection identifies `--no-open` support without starting a profile"},{"id":"p7s3","text":".
- **Custom title bar**: undecorated window with a Comfy-style **capsule control** (whale mark + na"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"me + arrow) centered — **click the capsule to open the environment panel** (blue highlight, arrow fl"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"ips while open); drag/min/max/close are self-drawn, native snap and edge-resize intact
- **Settings "},{"id":"p7s6","text":"workspace**: a two-column layout with General, Appearance, Environment, Updates and Logs; searchable"},{"id":"p7s7","text":" settings, icon navigation, keyboard controls and responsive layouts. The chat iframe stays mounted "},{"id":"p7s8","text":"while settings are open.
- **Appearance**: independent light/dark themes and previews, system mode, "},{"id":"p7s9","text":"DSH, Ocean, Forest, Violet, Amber and Rose presets, custom background/text/surface/frame colors and "},{"id":"p7s10","text":"surface contrast, UI/code fonts and sizes, pointer cursors, translucent sidebar, and theme copy/past"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"e/import/reset. Language now lives in General with system mode and six locales. Custom colors and fo"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"nts affect the desktop shell; chat light/dark mode follows after an app restart.
- **ComfyUI-style l"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"ogging**: dsh.log records only shell events (startup/supervision/updates; DSH's own output is not lo"},{"id":"p7s14","text":"gged), timestamped `[INFO/WARN/ERROR]` rows with level coloring, rotated per session; a 查看日志 link on"},{"id":"p7s15","text":" the boot page streams what the terminal is doing
- **Diagnostic bundle**: 更多 → 导出诊断信息 packs env fac"},{"id":"p7s16","text":"ts + the session log into markdown on your clipboard — paste it to any AI instead of hunting through"},{"id":"p7s17","text":" the install
- **Tray-resident**: closing the window (X) only hides it to the tray while DSH keeps r"},{"id":"p7s18","text":"unning; **double-click the tray icon** or **right-click → Open DSH** brings the window back; the men"},{"id":"p7s19","text":"u also has "重启 dsh web(后端)" (backend restart), "前后端重启" (full restart — shell and backend both, howev"},{"id":"p7s20","text":"er the backend was started) and the update check
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### Prerequisites (target machine)"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Not bundled with the exe:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Item | Requirement |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Node.js | ^22.19 or ≥ 24 (**required**; the Node version DSH declares) |
| DSH | optional, any of:"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" global install `npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh` (fastest, recommended); local install (`pnpm add @deepse"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ek-ai/dsh` beside the exe or in any searched dir); or click "下载并启动" on first launch to go through np"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"x |
| DSH version support | Legacy protocol and token/cookie authentication adapters are retained. v"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"1.6.65 adds real-backend connection regression coverage for **0.1.6-alpha.2 / 0.1.7-alpha.2**. Deskt"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"op updates do not require backend upgrades; third-party plugins require separate compatibility check"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"s. See verification |
| Running DSH from source | set the `DSH_CMD` (`pnpm dsh web`) and `DSH_CWD` ("},{"id":"p11s8","text":"DSH repo path) env vars |
| WebView2 | included with Windows 11 |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### How it works"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- The Rust side probes readiness via `POST /api/host.describe` (`result.ok === true`); launch runs a"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" local-first candidate chain: `DSH_CMD` env var (first candidate, falls through on failure) → custom"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" path from the boot page (persisted in `settings.json`) → `dsh web` (PATH-global, checked via `where"},{"id":"p13s4","text":" dsh`) → `node_modules\.bin\dsh.cmd` (exe dir / working dir / user profile) → a previously consented"},{"id":"p13s5","text":" `npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh web`; an empty chain emits `notfound` and the boot page offers a one-cl"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"ick `npm install -g` (run by the app), the npx fallback, and a manual path input — each candidate ha"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"s its own readiness window, falls through on failure with every attempt logged; the DSH web child is"},{"id":"p13s8","text":" spawned via `cmd /S /C` (CREATE_NO_WINDOW, absolute-path resolution); its output feeds a bounded in"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"-memory tail (crash-cause visibility only, never written to the log file — DSH keeps its own logs un"},{"id":"p13s10","text":"der `~/.dsh/logs`, and the shell log records only shell events, rotated per session)
- It listens to"},{"id":"p13s11","text":" the gateway's `$events` logical stream on `ws://127.0.0.1:3080/api/remote.mux`, authenticated with "},{"id":"p13s12","text":"the browser-session cookie from the webchat login exchange (dsh 0.1.2+ BrowserAuth, issue #18); on a"},{"id":"p13s13","text":" **true→false edge** of `running` in `api-session/status` while the window is hidden, it resolves th"},{"id":"p13s14","text":"e session title via `session/list` and fires the toast
- A bare exe has no installer, so Windows wou"},{"id":"p13s15","text":"ld silently drop toasts — the app registers its AppUserModelID in the registry at startup (`HKCU\Sof"},{"id":"p13s16","text":"tware\Classes\AppUserModelId\com.dsh.desktop`) to make notifications work"}],"truncated":true}
